def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Square Root of Product (SRP) Compact Model for the OTFT p-channel Org2."""
    
    # Calculate the square root of the product of gate and drain voltages
    V_sqrt_prod = np.sqrt(gate_voltage_abs * drain_voltage_abs)
    
    # Define threshold voltages (Vt) and subthreshold swing (S)
    Vt1 = parameters[0]       # threshold voltage for the linear region (transfer curve)
    Vt2 = parameters[1]       # threshold voltage for the saturation region (output curve)
    S = parameters[2] / 20    # subthreshold swing (typical value is around 60 mV/decade)
    
    # Calculate the current density (I_D = W * C_ox * V_th / L)
    C_ox = parameters[3]     # gate oxide capacity (typical value for copper: ~3.8e-6 F/cm2)
    L = parameters[4]        # channel length
    W = parameters[5]        # width (assuming equal width for all devices)
    
    # Calculate the intrinsic current density (ID_int)
    ID_int = C_ox * W / L * (parameters[6] * Vt1 - parameters[7])
    
    # Return the output in amperes (note that ID = ID_int when VDS = 0 and ID increases for VDS > 0)
    return ID_int * np.exp((V_sqrt_prod - Vt2) / S)
